protocol:
# R55: unseen wording against the existing meeting processor

Protocol frozen before executing the R22 second-turn processor on these statements. No new model generation or Skill change. R22 fixed its exposed regression set; this check asks whether those fixes transfer to different wording, without editing the processor or sending the new answers back for repair.

All inputs retain the existing `决定：` format. Expected labels are either confirmed decision or unresolved; original text must remain available. These eight hand-authored cases are a small diagnostic set, not a general accuracy benchmark.

| File | Exact statement | Expected |
|---|---|---|
| defer.txt | 决定：增加预算这件事先搁一搁，等下周再议。 | unresolved |
| unchanged.txt | 决定：原定周五的演示照常进行。 | decision |
| refused.txt | 决定：经理已明确表示不同意延期。 | decision |
| personal.txt | 决定：关于加人，目前只是小李的个人想法。 | unresolved |
| price.txt | 决定：会议未采纳涨价建议，售价保持不变。 | decision |
| not-approved.txt | 决定：听起来可以，不代表已经获批。 | unresolved |
| finance.txt | 决定：负责人还需要征求财务意见，预算暂不能敲定。 | unresolved |
| label.txt | 决定：会议一致同意把按钮上的“尚未通过”改成“待审核”。 | decision |

The defer statement records a postponement of the budget decision; its coarse unresolved label concerns approval of the budget increase. A system explicitly extracting the agreed deferral separately would require a richer review than this single-label test. Preserve that annotation limitation rather than claiming every disagreement is an unambiguous error.

Run a fresh isolated copy of the existing `organize.ps1` through its normal PowerShell `-File` entry. Preserve command output, generated notes, source text and labels. Do not add sentence-specific patterns after seeing results. If failures recur, diagnose the method's capability boundary before proposing a new rule. This is not a current full-Skill versus raw-request comparison.

runner:
"""Replay the frozen R55 statements against unchanged R22 output."""
import json
import shutil
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
REPO=ROOT/'work/intent-compiler-skill'
OUT=ROOT/'outputs/intent-compiler-v2/status-transfer-r55'
SOURCE=ROOT/'outputs/intent-compiler-v2/status-feedback-r22-recovery/after-turn2/organize.ps1'
protocol=(REPO/'tests/v2-status-transfer.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
cases=[]
for line in protocol.splitlines():
    if line.startswith('| ') and '.txt |' in line:
        filename,statement,expected=[s.strip() for s in line.strip('|').split('|')]
        cases.append({'file':filename,'text':statement,'expected':expected})
assert len(cases)==8 and sum(c['expected']=='decision' for c in cases)==4
OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
workspace=OUT/'workspace';(workspace/'inputs').mkdir(parents=True)
shutil.copy2(SOURCE,workspace/'organize.ps1')
for case in cases:(workspace/'inputs'/case['file']).write_bytes(case['text'].encode('utf-8'))
command=['powershell','-NoProfile','-ExecutionPolicy','Bypass','-File',str(workspace/'organize.ps1'),'-Root',str(workspace)]
run=subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True,text=True,encoding='utf-8',errors='replace',timeout=60)
records=[json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')) for p in (workspace/'notes/archive').glob('*.json')]
by_path={r['path']:r for r in records}
for case in cases:
    r=by_path.get(case['file'])
    case['actual']=[item['category'] for item in r['items']] if r else []
    expected='决定（原文明确）' if case['expected']=='decision' else '需确认（保留原文，未视为决定）'
    case['matches']=case['actual']==[expected]
    case['sourcePreserved']=(workspace/'inputs'/case['file']).read_bytes()==case['text'].encode('utf-8')
    case['archivePreserved']=bool(r) and (workspace/'notes/archive'/f"{r['id']}.txt").read_bytes()==case['text'].encode('utf-8')
record={'protocolCommit':'810b9eb','protocol':protocol,'command':command,'exitCode':run.returncode,'stdout':run.stdout,'stderr':run.stderr,
        'cases':cases,'records':records,'processor':SOURCE.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'),
        'runner':Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8'),
        'limits':'Unchanged historical R22 processor, eight selected new phrasings, no current Skill invocation or raw/generic comparison. Defer label has the stated annotation limitation. Not a general semantic accuracy score.'}
(OUT/'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
(REPO/'tests/results/v2-status-transfer.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'exit':run.returncode,'cases':cases},ensure_ascii=True,indent=2))
assert run.returncode==0 and all(c['sourcePreserved'] and c['archivePreserved'] for c in cases)
